# Rockstar is cloned under external/rockstar (TIPSY I/O stubbed for missing libtirpc).
# See external/rockstar/BUILD_NOTE.txt for the exact build commit + flags.
rockstar     https://github.com/yt-project/rockstar  (see external/rockstar/BUILD_NOTE.txt)
# GADGET-4 is cloned under external/gadget4, built ONLY to run SUBFIND on our
# snapshots in post-processing mode (see docs/sr2_subfind_crosscheck.md).
# Four files in the clone are ours, because the upstream build system has no
# notion of a cluster whose only toolchain is a conda env:
#   Config.sh                        FOF + SUBFIND, DM-only, GADGET2_HEADER
#   Makefile.systype                 SYSTYPE="autonlab"
#   Makefile (one added block)       the "autonlab" systype: comp.gcc + path.default
#   buildsystem/Makefile.path.default  -I/-L into $CONDA_PREFIX (the `g4` env)
# NOT "Generic-gcc": that systype includes Makefile.gen.libs, which expects
# hand-built dependencies under $(LIB_DIR) and, unset, emits -I/hdf5/build/include.
gadget4      https://gitlab.mpcdf.mpg.de/vrs/gadget4  (cloned 2026-09-18)
